repair_plan.repair: Keep the station out of the opening yard, show the limit as an uninstalled outline or off-street prototype with no flood measurement, keep one map across s8 and s9, restore clause-order performance in every scene for both treatments, and fix the code-visible pixel risks.
repair_plan.root_cause: The independent code critic found that the film draws an installed, measuring station in the opening yard and again at the close, which asserts a deployment and field outcome the sources deny, and that treatment B reverses event order under fixed narration in scenes s2, s3, s4 and s7 so clauses are pictured with another clause subject.
